_comment: Merged into ~/.paseo/config.json by `./install --apply`. Only these three keys
under agents.providers are added; nothing else in the operator's config is touched.
@@HOME@@ is rendered to $HOME at install time.
`models` REPLACES Paseo's runtime-discovered catalog rather than extending it.
That is deliberate: the seat should offer the routing table's ids and nothing
else, so a wrong pick is impossible from the UI. After any provider update,
inspect `paseo provider models kiro-peer --json` before widening this list.
Never use `additionalModels` here - it appends to the catalog instead of
replacing it, which reintroduces every model including the expensive ones.
Every id below was verified present on kiro-cli 2.26.0 on 2026-09-30.
Reasoning effort is NOT listed as a thinking option because Kiro's ACP surface
reports `thinkingOptions: "none"` for every model. Effort is pinned on the
kiro-room command line from the role overlay instead.

kiro-supervisor.label: Kiro Supervisor
kiro-supervisor.description: Portfolio governance seat using an isolated Kiro Room runtime. Observe and route; no writes.

kiro-lead.label: Kiro Lead
kiro-lead.description: Project technical authority using an isolated Kiro Room runtime. Delegates, verifies, accepts.

kiro-peer.label: Kiro Peer
kiro-peer.description: Bounded engineering seat without Paseo orchestration tools. Authority comes from the current brief.
